overall: Los Angeles is starting the day deep in a marine layer with fog and near-saturated conditions — the current temp of 64.4°F sits only 1.6°F below the dewpoint of 62.6°F, and the running max of 66.2°F was set at around midnight ET (roughly 9pm PT), meaning no meaningful daytime heating has occurred yet. Velocities are negative (-1.8°F/hr current, -3.1°F/hr over 30 min), consistent with pre-dawn radiative and marine influence holding temps flat-to-cooling in the early morning hours. This is a textbook June Gloom pattern persisting into early July — the marine layer and fog will be the primary limiter on afternoon warming.
forecast_obs_notes: There is meaningful NWP model spread: GFS (78.2°F) and ECMWF (77.3°F) are notably warmer than HRRR (75.6°F) and especially NBM (71.8°F), a ~6.4°F range that signals genuine forecast uncertainty. For the active even-bucket Kalshi market, the 72-73°F bucket appears well-supported as the top bet; confidence is moderate (Tier 2) given NWP model disagreement.
